definition: with a prolonged sound as made by the air passing out from a balloon.
example: ಬಲೂನಿನ ಗಾಳಿ ಪುಸ್ಸನೆ ಶಬ್ದ ಮಾಡುತ್ತ ಹೊರಟಿತು.
example_en: The air from the balloon went out with a prolonged hissing sound.

definition: the colour which varies in shade from that of blood to pale rose; red colour.
example_en: The red colour had spread across the evening sky.

definition: the finger nail.
example_en: The cat's finger nail was sharp.

definition: a species of onion; .
example_en: That species of onion grows in that region.

definition: to collect, glean flowers.
example_en: The children gleaned flowers in the garden and made a garland.

definition: loss of judgement power, intelligence or wisdom; madness.
example_en: Excessive grief brought madness upon her.

definition: to take a vow to die following the death of one's master.
example: ಒಡೆಯನ ಸಾವಿನ ನಂತರ ಸೇವಕ ವೇಳೆಗೊಳ್ಳಲು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: After his master's death, the servant resolved to take a vow to die.

definition: stopped; blocked; thwarted.
example_en: His work was stopped by obstacles.

definition: a small, usu. hard, tumorous growth on the skin, caused by a virus; a wart.
example_en: A wart has grown on his hand.

definition: a man who has neglected his duty, committed an offence, hurt others, etc.; an offender.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಗುಹ್ನೇಗಾರ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: The villagers called him an offender.

definition: a queen.
example_en: The queen sat in the royal court.

definition: the quality of adhereing, blending with or the fact of being adhered firmly or fused with, another.
example: ಬಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಗೋಡೆಯ ನಡುವೆ ಕಾಳಸ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: One can see the firm adherence between the paint and the wall.

definition: an incessantly pouring rain.
example_en: In the incessantly pouring rain, the farmers did not go to the field.

definition: the superintendent of a kitchen (in a palace).
example_en: The king's kitchen superintendent looked after the preparation of the meal.

definition: any deliberate procedure that removes or induces the expulsion of, a living or dead embryo or foetus; abortion.
example_en: On the doctor's advice she underwent an abortion.

definition: an administrative division of a state; a district.

example_en: A new officer was appointed to the new district.

definition: one time, occasion only.
example: ಈ ಔಷಧಿಯನ್ನು ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಒಮ್ಮಡಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸೇವಿಸಬೇಕು.

definition: (pl.) able, capable persons.
example: ಆ ಆರ್ಪರ್ ಈ ಕಷ್ಟಕರ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಬಲ್ಲರು.
example_en: Those capable persons can do this difficult task.

definition: to be followed by; to be chased.
example_en: The deer, chased by the hunter, ran into the forest.

definition: to move around or about.
example_en: The street dogs were moving around all over the town.

definition: (dial.) any of small rodents of Sciuridae family, living in trees, on the ground or in burrows and usu. having a long bushy tail; a squirrel.
example_en: The squirrel was leaping from branch to branch of the tree.

definition: a spindle to which a considerable length of thread is wound; a roll of thread.
example_en: There were many rolls of thread in the box.

definition: a kind of medicinal preparation.
example_en: Physicians give lokanatha rasa for weakness.

definition: deep mud; wet, soggy earth.
example_en: After the rain the field was full of deep mud.

definition: any small, rounded, usu. inflamed swelling of the skin; a papule or pustule; a pimple.
example_en: A pimple grew on his nose.

definition: to roll, rotate or turn the roller-stone (as in grinding kitchen ingredients or blending of mortar, etc.).
example_en: The cook rolled the grinding stone to make chutney.

definition: a woman who lives in a place as a resident (distinguished from a visitor or transient).
example_en: She is the long-time resident of this house.

definition: to give, send or do (something) what has been given or sent.
example_en: The teacher returned the offering given to him.

definition: a man belonging to Tamil Nadu, in south India or a Tamil-speaking man chiefly in Tamil Nadu or Sri Lanka.
example_en: That Tamil man is from Tamil Nadu.

definition: a toothed device of plastic, hard rubber, bone, wood or metal, used for untangling and arranging the hair; a comb.
example_en: She combed her hair with a comb.

definition: a man of deceitful artifice; a trickster; a crafty fellow; a mischievous person.
example: ಆ ಕಿಲಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಪರಾರಿಯಾದನು.
example_en: That trickster deceived everyone and escaped.

definition: the light, sharp, continuous chirping sounds as of birds.
example_en: The sharp chirping of the birds at dawn woke him up.

definition: a man engaged in menial or servile works for another; a slave.
example_en: That slave obeyed his master's command.

definition: an artful or secret plot or scheme, esp. one with evil intent; an evil design; machinations.
example_en: The king quickly detected the enemies' plot.

definition: the land belonging to one's administrative jurisdiction.
example_en: This administrative land is very fertile.

definition: a person lacking experience; an inexperienced person; a novice or a lay person.
example_en: The new worker is inexperienced in this field.

definition: to count; to reckon.
example_en: The shopkeeper counted the money carefully.

definition: the porpoise Delphinus gangeticus, an aquatic animal.
example_en: The porpoise was playing among the river waves.

definition: (pl.) two palms; both the palms (of a person).
example_en: He folded both his palms and bowed to the god.

definition: one of the states of South India having 130,356 sq. mt. area and Chennai as its capital; Tamil Nadu.
example_en: Chennai is the capital of the state of Tamil Nadu.

definition: the determination, resolution or perseverance as the requisite quality for being (continuously) successful.
example_en: Only one who has the determination to win finally attains success.

definition: resembling; comparing or comparable.
example_en: These two pictures are comparable to each other.

definition: the tree Ailanthus malabarica of Simaroubaceae family.
example_en: The gugguḷa tree grows abundantly in the forest.

definition: a jeering remark; a sarcastic saying.
example: ಅವನ ಕೊಱಚು ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಸಿಟ್ಟು ಬಂತು.
example_en: She got angry hearing his sarcastic remark.

definition: quickly; swiftly.
example_en: The children ate quickly and left.

definition: to do, perform (an action etc.) to carry out; to fulfil.
example_en: He carried out the teacher's order.

definition: that cannot be pervaded or passed through; impervious; impermeable.
example_en: That rubber layer is impermeable to water.

definition: (dial.) an injury in which the skin is not broken; a bruise; a contusion.
example: ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿಗೆ ಕನಿಪ್ಪೆ ಆಗಿದೆ, ನಡೆಯಲು ಕಷ್ಟವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: He has a bruise on his leg, so it is difficult to walk.

definition: a shower of flowers.
example_en: A shower of flowers fell upon the deity.

definition: lack of tolerance, intolerance.
example_en: His intolerance was known to everyone.

definition: a roaring sound.
example_en: The lion's roaring sound echoed throughout the forest.

definition: a male monarch of a major territorial unit, esp. one whose position is hereditary and who rules for life; a king.
example: ಆ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ನೃಪಾಳಕ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನು ನ್ಯಾಯದಿಂದ ಆಳಿದನು.
example_en: The king of that kingdom ruled the subjects justly.

definition: a woman who believes and trusts the God.
example_en: That God-fearing woman used to go to the temple every day.

definition: a lazy or lethargic fellow.
example: ಆ ಹಡುಕುಳಿ ಇಡೀ ದಿನ ಮಲಗಿಯೇ ಇರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That lazy fellow stays lying down the whole day.

definition: the quality of being sensitive to beauty; the inclination for aesthetic value and consideration; aesthetic sense.
example_en: Her aesthetic sense is clearly visible in her painting.

definition: a man holding a bow; an archer.
example_en: Arjuna was a great archer.

definition: that bears, gives fruits.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಾವಿನ ಮರ ತುಂಬಾ ಫಲವಂತವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This year the mango tree is very fruitful.

definition: a moving, playing, leaping, jumping lightly and gaily as from joy.
example_en: The child ran about playfully leaping with joy.

definition: Ānjanēya, one of the famous gods, with the face and tail of a monkey, a devout servant of Śri Rāmacandra, in Rāmāyaṇa.
example_en: They worship the idol of Hanuman in the temple every day.

definition: the frame of a carriage, esp of a chariot; chassis.
example_en: The chassis of the chariot was made of wood.

definition: bent; bowed.
example_en: She stood bowed before the teacher.

definition: a press or mill used to extract juice from sugarcane or oil from oil seeds.
example: ರೈತರು ಕಬ್ಬನ್ನು ಘಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಕಿ ರಸ ತೆಗೆದರು.
example_en: The farmers put the sugarcane into the press and extracted the juice.

definition: to be seized or taken into custody by another; to be arrested.
example_en: The thief was seized and taken into custody by the guards.

definition: to look staringly or without blinking the eyes, at.
example_en: He stared unblinkingly at the enemy.

definition: a skin disease characterised by irritation and dryness of the skin.
example_en: He developed dry, irritated skin during winter.

definition: a religion founded by the Mughal king Akbar, which included the essence of different religions.
example: ಅಕ್ಬರ ಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿ ದೀನ್‍ಇಲಾಹಿ ಎಂಬ ಧರ್ಮವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದನು.

definition: a woman who has the legal, moral or social right (over something).
example_en: She is the rightful woman heir to that property.

definition: the tree Gardenia resinifera (= G. lucida) of Rubiaceae family.
example_en: The gardenia tree in the forest has bloomed.

definition: an act of or fit to be of, a hero; a gallant act.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕನ ಆರ್ಪುಗೆಯ್ತ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಪಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That soldier's gallant, heroic act earned everyone's admiration.

definition: the sky.
example_en: The moon was shining in the sky.

definition: that which is got, earned.
example_en: His earnings decreased.

definition: any article of clothing; garment; clothes.
example_en: She bought new clothes for the festival.

definition: (dial) intestinal inflammation characterised by abdominal pain and frequent and intense diarrhoea with bloody, mucous faeces; dysentery.
example: ಕೊಳಕು ನೀರು ಕುಡಿದು ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಅಳ್ನೆತ್ತಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: The child got dysentery from drinking dirty water.

definition: the state of being elated by joy, enthusiasm, characterised by cheerfulness and much action, liveliness, etc.
example_en: On the festival day all the children were playing with great elation.

definition: the quality of being respectful.
example_en: The respectability of the teacher created reverence among the disciples.

definition: the nozzle of a water-vessel.
example_en: The nozzle of that vessel was nicely carved.

definition: having a curve or surface protruded or rounded like the outer side of a circle or sphere, as distinct from concave; convex.

definition: the act of seeing or being seen.
example_en: As soon as the moon was sighted, the festival began.

definition: the state of being unconscious for a temporary period.
example: ಅಪಘಾತದ ನಂತರ ಆತನಿಗೆ ಮಱೆಹಿಡಿಕೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.

definition: to touch with the hand.

definition: to go; to move on.

definition: a man of this place.

definition: to suffer from breathing difficulty; to pant for breath.

definition: the colour of ochre; reddish brown.

definition: Śiva, who uses snakes as armlets.

definition: to grieve; to worry; to be subject to botheration.

definition: the plant Pavonia zeylanica of Malvaceae family.

definition: a rich fabric as of silk, rayon or nylon with a soft, thick pile; velvet.

definition: the crescent moon.

definition: Kannaḍa one of the major Dravidian languages, and the official language of, and chiefly spoken by the people of, Karnāṭaka.

definition: bodily confort or pleasure.

definition: otherwise; in other circumstances.

definition: to become subjected to; to fall under the control of another; to be, become, captivated.

definition: a large container made of interwoven bamboo strips.

definition: a blow; a stroke.

definition: that is to be conveyed using a boat or ship.

definition: to lend money; to loan.
example_en: He lent some money to his friend.

definition: to become unable to walk or move forward.
example_en: He became unable to walk forward in the darkness and stopped.

definition: a close, intimate friend; a bosom friend.
example_en: He is my bosom friend from childhood.

definition: a beautiful face.
example_en: Her beautiful face captivated everyone's heart.

definition: a derisive, contemptuous speech.
example_en: Everyone felt insulted hearing his derisive speech.

definition: to heat (a metal) to make (it) have right temperment.
example_en: The blacksmith heated the iron to temper it and made a weapon.

definition: a deep and wide trench filled with water; a moat.

definition: bitter or acrid taste; bitterness.

example_en: The child who had measles had red spots on the body.

definition: a man who constructs; a constructor.
example: ಈ ಸೇತುವೆಯ ರಚನಕಾರ ಬಹಳ ಕುಶಲ ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರ್.
example_en: The constructor of this bridge is a very skilled engineer.

definition: the head.
example_en: His head got injured when he fell.

definition: esteem for or a sense of the worth or excellence of a person, a personal quality or ability or something considered as a manifestation of a personal quality or ability; respect.
example_en: He has good respect in society.

definition: the formation of ova; ovulation.
example_en: Ovulation takes place at that stage.

definition: a small, slender piece of steel with a sharp point at one end and a hole for thread at the other, used for sewing by hand or for surgical sutures; a needle.
example_en: Grandmother sewed the torn cloth with a needle.

definition: the fire-pit of a smith.

example_en: The blacksmith sat near the fire-pit and heated the iron.

definition: an actor who arranges the plot of a drama and takes a leading part in the prelude.
example: ಆ ನಾಟಕದ ನಟವರ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: The lead actor-director of that drama won the audience's praise.

definition: in a hot manner; hotly; hot.

definition: a formal and binding declaration that one will do or refrain from doing something; an oath.

definition: the fact or condition of being necessary or necessarily wanted; an imperative requirement.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಹಣದ ದರಜು ಇದೆ.
example_en: This work has a necessary requirement for more money.

definition: to inform before hand.
example_en: He informed us beforehand.

definition: a hard, heavy blow.

definition: to apply one's mind to attentively; to try to learn or understand by reading, thinking, etc; to study.
example_en: The student studied the lessons for the exam.

definition: both the ends of a sari.

definition: a kind of black tooth-powder.
example_en: She was smiling after applying the black tooth-powder.

definition: a source of a stream, river.
example_en: The source of this river is at the foot of the hill.

definition: a counterfiet coin or currency note.

definition: the feeling of owning, having, possessing something as one's own; concern with one's own possessions, relation, etc.; possessiveness.

example_en: Excessive possessiveness toward money makes a person selfish.

definition: mud, dirt mixed with water; slime; mire; slush.
example_en: After the rain, the path was full of mud and slush.

definition: to restrain oneself; to keep oneself under control.
example_en: However much he was provoked, the sage restrained himself.

definition: engaged in or tending to engage in, comforting, solacing or consoling.
example_en: Her words were in a comforting tone.

definition: any of a family (Pectinidae) of bivalves with two deeply grooved, convex shells and an earlike wing on each side of the hinge, that swims by rapidly snapping its shells together to expel water in a jet like manner; a scallop.

definition: to be in complete agreement; to be unified.

example_en: The planets' orbit is in the shape of an ellipse.

example_en: The mother fondled the child with affectionate words and comforted it.

example_en: The gods live in the capital city of the gods.

definition: a man who hatches or takes part in a conspiracy; a conspirator.

example_en: A heavy battle took place between the two kingdoms.

definition: a hole in a rock or in the stem or big branch of a tree.

example_en: A sparrow had built its nest in that hole of the tree.

definition: (in pl.) three sensual organs - the skin, tongue and nose.

definition: the tree Michelia nilagirica of Magnoliaceae family.
example_en: They have planted a Michelia nilagirica tree in the garden.

definition: (astrol.) Rāhu, one of the nine planets that are believed to rule the destiny of human beings.
example: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿಗಳ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಚಾೞ್ ಗ್ರಹ ಶುಭಫಲ ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: According to astrologers, the planet Rahu does not bring auspicious results.

definition: a state of ease and quiet enjoyment, free from worry, pain or trouble; comfort.
example_en: The baby was lying comfortably in its mother's lap.

example_en: The government forbade smoking in public places.

example_en: This treatise contains a description of the sixty-four arts.

example_en: They placed a wooden beam as support against the wall.

example_en: The applicants were waiting in the office's hall.

definition: afterwards; subsequently.
example_en: Peace settled subsequently after the war ended.

example_en: The banadurgi tree had grown abundantly in the forest.

definition: a pillow filled with feathers, air, foam rubber, etc. or a soft pad for sitting or kneeling on or reclining against; a cushion.
example_en: The cushion on the sofa was very soft.

example_en: He defrauded his friend for his own selfish gain.

example_en: The evening sunlight shone like gold on the hills.

example_en: Society remains backward because of lack of education.

example_en: The rain started all of a sudden.

example_en: The government gave privileges to poor students.

definition: a kind of flat and round percussion instrument, with a short brim, on which a skin membrane is tightly spread, and usu. played with two sticks.
example_en: People danced at the fair while the tamate drum was played.

definition: not many; a small number of; a few.
example_en: Only a few people had come to the meeting.

definition: an agricultural implement used for cutting, lifting, turning over, and partly pulverising soil; a plough.
example: ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ರೈತರು ನೇಗಲಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಟರು.
example_en: In the morning the farmers set out to the field holding the plough.

definition: an acute, severe, infectious disease caused by bacteria (Vibrio cholerae) and characterised by profuse diarrhea, intestinal pain, and dehydration; cholera.
example_en: Cholera spread due to contaminated water.

definition: to form a line, row (by making a number of persons, animals, things, etc. standing one behind the other).
example_en: The teacher told the students to form a line.

definition: monopolistic - having sole power, privilege of dealing with something; b) being under sole possession or command of a person.
example: ಆ ಕಂಪನಿ ಈ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕಸ್ವಾಮಿಕ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: That company holds a monopolistic position in this market.

definition: that cannot be overlooked, underestimated or disregarded.
example_en: The matter of safety cannot be overlooked; it should not be disregarded.

definition: great lustre.
example_en: The great lustre of the gold ornament attracted everyone.

definition: a long piece of resinous wood or twisted tow dipped in tallow, etc., flaming at one end, used as a portable light; a torch.
example: ಕಗ್ಗತ್ತಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂಡಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಅವರು ದಾರಿ ನಡೆದರು.
example_en: Holding a torch, they walked the path in the pitch darkness.

definition: to discharge the contents of; to empty.
example_en: The workers emptied out the sacks in the warehouse.

example_en: A crowd of villagers had gathered under the pandal.

example_en: Her husband's journey increased the anguish of separation in her.

definition: the act of scratching with the fingers or toes.
example_en: The cat scratched at the door.

definition: to give lessons to; to instruct, educate; to coach; to train.
example_en: The teacher trained the students in music.

definition: a dismissing or being dismissed; a dismissal.
example_en: News of the officer's dismissal spread everywhere.

definition: a kind of bird ( = an owl ?).
example_en: The gumme bird lived in the hollow of that tree.

definition: the language of the Greeks, constituting a separate branch of the Indo-European language family; Greek.
example_en: He has learned the Greek language well.

definition: a visionary notion or scheme; a wishful creation of the imagination; a dreaming indulged in while awake; daydream.
example_en: He sat daydreaming a wishful fantasy of becoming rich.

definition: that which hampers the progress, movement or execution of a plan; an obstacle; an impediment.
example_en: Without removing this obstacle, the work will not proceed.

definition: a thing to be done; work; affair; business.
example_en: This work must be finished soon.

definition: the quality of resisting any control, restrain.
example: ಅವನ ಸೂಕಳತೆಯಿಂದ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಹತೋಟಿಗೆ ತರಲಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his unruliness, no one could bring him under control.

definition: a man guarding a fort; a fort-watchman.
example_en: The fort-watchman stood guard at the fort's gate.

definition: a lord; a master.
example_en: That master was very kind-hearted.

definition: rain drop or rain water.
example: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲಿನ ಮೇಘಪುಷ್ಪ ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The raindrops on the leaves glistened in the morning sunlight.

definition: the military sea force of a nation; naval force; Navy.
example_en: The nation's naval force guards the border.

definition: a business deal or agreement; a transaction.
example_en: A business deal was struck between the two.

definition: to become unpleasantly rough or sharp to the ear; to be irritative.
example_en: That sound became irritative to the ear.

definition: an appellation given to a person or family as a sign of privilege or distinction; a title.
example: ರಾಜನು ಅವನಿಗೆ ವೀರ ಎಂಬ ಬಿರುದು ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The king gave him the title of 'Veera'.

definition: a cloud, that gives water.
example_en: The rain cloud was floating in the sky.

definition: a road or area where prostitutes live.
example_en: The police were patrolling the street where prostitutes live.

definition: a god, deity.
example_en: People worshipped the deity in the temple.

definition: an evasive, equivocal or tricky talk.
example_en: No one believed his evasive talk.

definition: (things) to be kept one above the other; to get piled up.
example: ಮಳೆಯಿಂದ ಒದ್ದೆಯಾದ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ಮೇಜಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಡಕಿಲ್ವೊಂದಿದವು.
example_en: The books soaked by the rain got piled up on the table.

definition: to pick up.
example_en: He picked up the coin from the ground.

definition: to hold or seize firmly.
example_en: She held the door frame firmly.

example_en: The tuber of that sweet potato plant was cooked tastefully.

example_en: Both of them settled the price.

definition: a female prisoner.
example: ಆ ಬಂದಿನಿ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಸೆರೆಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ದಳು.

definition: hanging loosely or in disorder; unkempt; dishevelled.

definition: a man who explains the meaning of mythoilogical, philosophical, theosophical texts to general people.

definition: a place from where building stone, slate or the like, is obtained by cutting, blasting, etc.; a quarry.

example_en: There is a big stone quarry near that hill.

definition: a caste.
example_en: The Goniga caste is commonly found in the village.

definition: the spreading annual vine Arachis hypogea of Papilionaceae family with yellow flowers and brittle pods ripening underground and containing one to three edible seeds.
example_en: They had sown groundnut on the bund of the paddy field.

definition: to be subject to another's control or jurisdiction.
example_en: That institution is subject to the state government's control.

example_en: The real meaning of this poem is not yet clear.

example_en: Some people in the crowd made a commotion, shouting aloud.

definition: dark; dark-complexioned; black.

definition: to have tender, affection feeling for; to love.

definition: to convey an information, idea etc. through spoken words; to tell.

definition: a brave fighter.
example_en: He became famed as a brave fighter in the battle.

definition: a plain paper used to write, type on (diff. from the bond paper).
example_en: The clerk wrote the letter on plain paper.

definition: in the company of; in conjunction with; in association with.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಕೂಡ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: He set out on the journey in the company of his friends.

definition: a funeral ground.
example_en: Silence had settled over the funeral ground.

definition: an act of searching; a search.
example_en: The search for the lost key continued.

definition: affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function; sick; diseased; ill.
example_en: They took the sick person to the hospital.

definition: a very young child.
example_en: The mother picked up that very young child.

definition: an eye that is large and round.
example_en: The baby's large round eye charmed everyone.

definition: to raise or erect one's head.
example_en: In the joy of victory, he stood raising his head.

definition: a ladle or spoon.
example_en: The cook served the curry with the ladle.

definition: in small quantity, number, size, etc.
example_en: Only a small quantity of salt remained in the vessel.

definition: to throw, scatter or dash a liquid in small particles or drops; to spatter.
example_en: The child spattered water everywhere with its hand.

definition: a man in the tenth decade of his age, i.e. in between 91st year and 100th year.
example_en: That elder is a man in his tenth decade of age.

definition: the fact of being separated.
example_en: The separation of lovers is an unbearable pain.

definition: a wide stretch of open field, having no buildings.
example_en: That wide open field would turn green in the rainy season.

definition: an office or position offered or held as an honour.
example_en: The king honoured him by granting him an honorary position.

definition: a type of necklace having attractive beads of gold.
example_en: They gave the bride a golden mohanamale necklace as a gift.

definition: a going away; departure.
example_en: His departure brought sorrow to everyone.

definition: strong; vigorous.
example: ಆ ಬಲ್ಲಿದ ಯೋಧ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಶತ್ರುಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That vigorous warrior faced the enemies alone.

definition: any of numerous diurnal insects of the order Lepidoptera, characterised by clubbed antennae, a slender body, and large, broad, often conspicuously marked wings; a butterfly.
example: ಉದ್ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಜಿಟ್ಟೆ ಹೂವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A colorful butterfly sat on the flower in the garden.

definition: depending on; supported by.
example_en: The pillar supported by the wall held up the house.

definition: a wealthy man.
example: ಆ ಸಾವುಕಾರ ಊರಿನ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಸಾಲ ನೀಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That wealthy man used to give loans to the people of the town.

definition: (mus.) name of one of the (one hundred and eight kinds of) time-cycles.
example_en: That musician sang in the simhalila time-cycle.

definition: a kind of herb .
example: ವೈದ್ಯ ಜೂಜಕ್ಕಿ ಎಂಬ ಗಿಡವನ್ನು ಔಷಧಿಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದನು.
example_en: The physician used the jujakki herb for medicine.

definition: the condition of being not awre of one's body or one's surroundings; unconsciousness.
example: ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮೈಮರೆತ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Absorbed in his work, he fell into a state of unconsciousness of his surroundings.

definition: to sit; to be seated.
example_en: The teacher sat calmly on the seat.

definition: lower in quality or value than; inferior to.
example_en: This cloth is inferior in quality to that cloth.

definition: the erstwhile name for the region Dharwaḍa and its surroundings, in northern Karnāṭaka.
example_en: The people of the Belavala region speak Kannada.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example_en: That baby's navel has still not dried up.

definition: any game played with a ball.
example_en: The children played a ball game in the field.

definition: nimbleness, agility of the body.
example_en: The player's agility amazed everyone.

definition: the highest portion on a fortification.
example_en: Soldiers were on guard at the highest portion of the fortification.

definition: that is fallen or slipped down.
example_en: They carefully removed those fallen stones.

definition: to restrain oneself; to keep oneself under control.
example_en: Even after the insult, she restrained herself and remained patient.

definition: any vessel of considerable size (larger than a boat), propelled by sails or powered by an engine, navigating deep water; a ship.
example_en: The ship carrying goods arrived at the port.

definition: a set of two objects (of the same class); a pair.
example_en: She bought a pair of bangles.

definition: to put together; to bring together; to cause to assemble; to accumulate; to consolidate.
example_en: The organizers consolidated all the information together.

definition: a load, burden.
example: ಕೂಲಿಯಾಳು ಬೆನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ಭಾರೀ ಬಾದಿ ಹೊತ್ತನು.
example_en: The laborer carried a heavy load on his back.
